annotation.title_clean: Teaching and Crafting Human-Robot Relational Ethics
annotation.title_en: Teaching and Crafting Human-Robot Relational Ethics
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Kudina, O.; Mollen, J.; Viader Guerrero, J.; Muravyov, D.; Bermúdez, J.P.
annotation.venue: SEFI Journal of Engineering Education Advancement
annotation.summary_en: Journal article reflecting on a pilot redesign of TU Delft's Robots and Society MSc course, teaching relational and care ethics through students crafting and interacting with a companion robot. It offers lessons learned for integrating relational ethics into engineering curricula; it is not a regulatory instrument.
key_provisions_or_claims: Shifts ethics teaching from applying ethical theories to exploring human-robot relations via relational, more-than-human ethics.
Four tutorials on identifying, performing, repairing and sustaining caring relations with a companion robot.
Final essay asks 'How to live well with robots?' supported by visual evidence, partly addressing generative AI in assessment.
Offers considerations and challenges for integrating relational ethics into engineering curricula.
